text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look at this Special Carrot Buffet! It 
says all-you-can-eat carrot dishes! It 
looks so delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Potage, marinade, sauté, and poêlé. Cakes, 
parfaits, and even ice cream... As 
expected of a luxury hotel buffet.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Luxury...? Wah! Th-This price might be a 
bit out of my reach..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In that case... shall I make it? Let's 
host a carrot cuisine buffet back at the 
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? You can make them? All these fancy, 
high-class dishes!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll look up some recipes and 
practice. I'll be waiting for your 
requests, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?! Wah, what should I pick...! 
There are so many things I want to eat~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, leave it to me. Even if it's a 
tricky recipe, I'll give it my all for 
Spe-san's sake.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...! R-Really...!? Are you truly okay with 
me... ordering this much... and this 
much... !?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-sanâyes, of course. Leave everything 
from prep to cooking to me. I will 
certainly live up to your expectations, 
Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san...! Then, can I make a request 
right away...?! Could you make a version 
of this sauté with way, way more carrots?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me! I'll put my whole 
heart into making it delicious.
